gen-tourney-gf-mitr: Punchy and stretched wide: Tourney cuts every stroke to a single width. Mitr keeps long paragraphs friendly and compact, its lowercase rising almost to the height of the capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-momo-trust-display: Momo Trust Display lets its letters drift apart beneath Tourney, whose curves match its stems in thickness. Momo Trust Display reads with generous lowercase height, so longer text feels spacious and clean.
gen-tourney-gf-mukta: Tourney looks like cut lengths of cord, round-edged strokes all one width, spaced wide. Mukta, a sans with tall-bodied lowercase, makes longer text feel clean and unhurried as the lines go by.
gen-tourney-gf-mukta-mahee: Athletic Tourney holds a tube-like thickness through every bend, while Mukta Mahee stays chunky, approachable, and tall in the lowercase. What they share is sturdy weight, from headline down to text.
gen-tourney-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar is a sans whose ascenders stay compressed. What stands out is the split: Tourney looks laser-cut from sheet with one stroke width, while Mukta Malar stays low-key and approachable.
gen-tourney-gf-mukta-vaani: Tourney keeps a monoweight stroke from first letter to last, stretched wide and heavy. Mukta Vaani, a sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase, carries longer text in a contemporary, unfussy way.
gen-tourney-gf-narnoor: Narnoor, a sans with short ascenders above big bowls, handles the quiet, steady work of text. And Tourney, free of calligraphic swelling, does its best work stretched wide and shouting.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-display: Tourney looks laser-cut from a sheet, every stroke one width, and loudness is its best trick. Noto Sans Display, a sans-serif with a big, tall middle zone, is best at being approachable.
gen-tourney-gf-play: Play, a sans with little height difference between cases, thins its diagonals slightly, as if gently pressed. Play is best at quiet texture, while Tourney, one flat line weight throughout, is best at volume.
gen-tourney-gf-port-lligat-sans: Modern and snug: Port Lligat Sans packs letters like pins in a cushion. In Tourney, round letters carry walls matching the straight ones, and that bulky consistency against such a tightly packed body is the standout.
